title: More community apps across chat, images, audio, video, and builds
summary:
A community-directory day: new apps across the stack, repaired links, and fresh greenhouse telemetry.

The app showcase grew in several directions at once: Nexus AI joined video and audio, AI Image Generator joined image, MonaChat.jp and Architecture-updated- joined chat, and an AI router was added to the build category. A small directory expansion, but a useful reminder that people keep finding new shapes for the same HTTP calls.

Several app URLs were updated, making the showcase less likely to send visitors on a brief archaeological expedition through stale links.

Automated app metrics, health checks, and greenhouse status were refreshed so the community directory keeps reflecting its current state rather than yesterday's memory of it.
